Maximum sustained wind.subject: Meteorology & Climate
Maximum sustained wind.question: The _____ was Intensity indicator of tropical cyclone.
Maximum sustained wind.fact: The maximum sustained wind associated with a tropical cyclone is a common indicator of the intensity of the storm. Wind measuring has been standardized globally to reflect the winds at 10 meters (33 ft) above mean sea level, and the maximum sustained wind represents the highest average wind over either a one-minute (US) or ten-minute time span (see the definition, below), anywhere within the tropical cyclone.

Nanga Parbat.fact: Nanga Parbat, known in Shina as Diamer, is the ninth-highest mountain on Earth with its summit at 8,126 m (26,660 ft) above sea level.
